ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (distal lobes) to low-intensity black pixels (central and proximal regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are mapped to the distal 40% of the left lobe and the distal 35% of the right lobe. A large, continuous low-intensity black region dominates the center, extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge. A distinct high-contrast vertical black band is mapped to the distal third of the right lobe, bisecting the white region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 112 degrees and a bounding-box depth of 45 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the distal 50% of both lobe edges, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes varying between 4 and 12 pixels. The inner edges near the median notch exhibit a lower frequency, smoother topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve fitting the outer edges of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 15 small, circular high-contrast white clusters distributed across the dark central fluke region; dark circular focal spots are mapped within the white distal zones, particularly on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark, vertical linear mark on the right distal lobe; several faint, diagonal parallel linear disruptions are visible on the inner-white region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized irregular erosion and reddish-brown pixel artifacts on the extreme left distal tip; irregular chipping along the right lobe trailing edge boundary.
